question: Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5890570e614137efaadf6aab8162c4c0db6e032debf09d70bfc2ae96da8a7e7f.png]
solution:
The figure which will replace the question mark (?) in the given series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e03ebdcf13211136a8cbf99bafddbb9fb320577b5a08034f3550206d6b27c2ff.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• **Direction of arrows** is changing from **clockwise to anti-clockwise and vice-versa** in every step.
 
• The** no. of arrows are increasing by +1** in each step forward.
 
• The 4th figure has **4 arrows in anti-clockwise direction**, so 5th figure will have **5 arrows in clockwise direction**.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3)**.
